items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: being featured there was Stuff Smith and his orchestra

ctx.x: To go back to the drummers that I mentioned, I find out upon reviewing that I left out one -- Cozie Cole's name, for one. When I was first with, I first knew him, when I went with Artie Shaw in '36, and we were in New York, he took me over and he says, I want you to hear a drummer -- because I had a lot to learn, and Artie knew this, and he wanted me to hear some of the things that he liked.

And he took me over to the Three Deuces at the Onyx Club -- I guess maybe it was the Onyx Club, and being featured there was Stuff Smith and his orchestra; they had come out of Buffalo, New York, and this was the swingingest, damnest band I heard, and the walls almost came down with the pulsing beat, and that was Cozy Cole with his dancing slippers on, playing drums, Stuff Smith, I'm not sure of the
rest of the orchestra, but it was a small six piece band, and it was the damnest thing. You have to do your own research on that.
